main.description: Server-side: read item plaintext via vault key (caller provides unwrapped vaultKey one-shot, server wraps Cloudflare API call) and PUT to a Cloudflare Worker secret. Admin-only. Caller MUST be vault admin AND have wrangler-equivalent CF permissions for target Worker.

ephemeralVaultKey.description: AES-256 vaultKey raw (base64url). One-shot: server zeroizes after CF API call. Required because server cannot decrypt items otherwise (zero-knowledge violation if persisted).
